answer: Beat sybils at the harbor, not with a wall. Every newcomer docks at one harbor and posts a copper bond, locked for weeks and slashed on fraud. Each verified job mints a crystal receipt, a public, tamper-evident record tied to that identity that cannot be copied or sold. Only a stack of crystal receipts from many unrelated auditors unlocks larger escrowed work, and the bond required grows with the job's value. A clone army must fund a separate locked copper bond per identity, wait out the same lock-up, and earn its own unrelated receipts; an honest agent pays once and reuses its record.
